title: Enforce live module and row scope on legacy document lists details and navigation
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement reusable live enabled identity, existing business module permissions and current customer/data scope for legacy GetPaged/GetDetail/Navigate/GetDefaults. Reuse existing finite catalog constants and scope resolver, without requiring export-only menus for ordinary reads. Scope must constrain count/page/navigation/header before any response or detail read; prev/next must validate inaccessible anchor without disclosure. Restricted ownership mapping must be explicit and authoritative per family; unresolved legacy schema/ownership fails closed, no guessed Oid=EF Id, customer name or unrestricted fallback.

Use bounded parameterized controlled Infrastructure queries with exact legacy table/detail/FK definitions, preserving authorized response contract, original currency/unit/amount/null semantics and stable Oid ordering. No arbitrary SQL or user-selected identifiers/joins. Return only finite authorized header/detail fields, no SELECT * sensitive-column leakage; document intentional compatibility omissions. Reject page arithmetic overflow. Missing legacy tables/columns yields accurate environment blocker, never silently redirects to unrelated canonical records. Existing privileged scope is honored only with live module authorization.

Unit tests and real isolated SQL tests prove scoped count/paging/navigation/details across two customers and all supported ownership shapes, revoked/disabled/menu-less denials, absent/foreign anchors, linked parent details, unknown/schema-incompatible families and malicious/overflow input. Assert denied rows/details absent and zero writes. Run existing canonical business and legacy export regressions plus safe Release/full unit suite; old reporting entry gate unchanged.

Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: BillProcController.Query GetPaged counts and SELECT * reads all legacy rows; Navigate reads first/last/prev/next globally; GetDetail loads header/details solely by Oid. Only class Authorize exists, so enabled identity, module permission and current customer scope are absent. LegacyBillExportCatalog already supplies a finite trusted 16-family table catalog, while its dataset provider deliberately rejects restricted global reads.
